description: Declare exit and aexit methods with the three standard arguments or star-args, annotated as object or as the exception type, exception and traceback each unioned with None.

violation.message: Give `$M` three positional parameters after `self` (exception type, exception, traceback) or `*args: object`; the interpreter always passes those three.
Annotate the star-args of `$M` as `object`; they only receive the exception type, exception and traceback, which the method need not read through their types.
Give every positional parameter of `$M` beyond the exception type, exception and traceback a default value; the interpreter passes only those three.
Give every keyword-only parameter of `$M` a default value; the interpreter passes only the three positional arguments.
Annotate the first argument of `$M` as `type[BaseException] | None`, or as `object`; the interpreter passes `None` when no exception occurred.
Annotate the second argument of `$M` as `BaseException | None`, or as `object`; the interpreter passes `None` when no exception occurred.
Annotate the third argument of `$M` as `types.TracebackType | None`, or as `object`; the interpreter passes `None` when no exception occurred.
Annotate the three arguments after `self` of these `$NAME` overloads as either `None, None, None` or `type[BaseException], BaseException, types.TracebackType`.
